name: Hawkeye

abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fragility: Gelen saldırıların kritik hasar oranını artırır ve blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Critical Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

signatureAbility:
Hemorrhage
Landing a Critical Hit with an Arrow Shot will cause any personal Bleed Debuff triggered to become a Critical Bleed, multiplying the Bleed's Potency by Hawkeye's Critical Damage Multiplier.
Additionally each Bleed Debuff on the opponent reduces their Physical Resistance by [407.29 - 723.55].

abilitySections.title: Dialed In
content: During Special Attacks, press the Block Input after the first hit to slow down time. Releasing the Block Input precisely when Hawkeye releases the arrow grants a Perfect Release bonus.

Activating a Perfect Release bonus grants a Dialed In Passive, increasing duration of personal Debuffs inflicted by Arrow strikes by 10%. All Dialed In Passives are removed when failing to activate a Perfect Release. Max Stacks: 5.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: Pause all Bleed Debuffs on the opponent for 1 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Causes a Slow Debuff on the opponent for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Final Hit: 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff dealing [10,266] direct damage over 10 seconds. Each bar of Power spent beyond 1 grants +1 Debuff and +5 seconds Duration.
Perfect Release: Arrow attack becomes a Guaranteed Critical Hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict Power Drain, removing 75% of a bar of Power.
Perfect Release: 100% chance to inflict a Suppression Debuff, reducing the Opponents Combat Power Rate by 50% for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict a 25 second Fragility Debuff. Attacking a Fragile Opponent grants +[1,178.57] Critical Damage Rating and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
Perfect Release: Inflict an additional Fragility Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: All Bleeds triggered during this attack gain up to +200% duration based on Hawkeye's Critical Rating.
Based on Hawkeye's Critical Chance, Bleeds triggered during this attack can be Critical Bleeds, multiplying the Bleed's Potency by Hawkeye's Critical Damage Multiplier.
Getting a Perfect result in the Special 3 Mini-Game grants Maximum Critical Rating for the attack.
